It verifies against the stated targets (125ms p90, 160ms p99) and the 360 rpm growth figure. This covers the vast majority of the expected diagnostic chain and conclusions, even if some exact arithmetic details (average ~85ms implying one slow member) are not explicitly spelled out numerically in the same way.</reasoning>
